name: northshire_open_world_test
status: draft (test layout, not a mapped route)
notes: A three-pack open-world test layout, not a route: the driver's --enter none mode is exercised against it. The points are the public starting-area coordinates this repository already uses in its login fixture and its navmesh test (-8913 -136 82 and the two points 18 and 78 yd north of it); the packs are public low-level creatures of that area. No capture, no live walk: replace it with a mapped route before using it for anything but the open-world smoke test.
Every pack is a single point; use radius 12 so a wandering member stays inside its group and does not claim a neighbour's.
The leg's end is the entrance: the smoke test starts on the first pack and must not walk a line through a later pack before its turn.
